## Verified impact (simulated re-score, deterministic)

Applying the two artifacts to the audited profile and re-scoring with the frozen
ABI engine:

```
ABI overall:        39.0  F   →   53.3  D     (+14.3)
AI Retrieval        25.9      →   56.9        (FAQ content + answers)
Semantic Authority  21.5      →   65.4        (business + FAQ schema)
```

Consistency check: all three FAQ answers **pass AIVE's own `faq_validator`** — they
are genuine question/answer pairs, not CTAs. The fix raises the score *for the right
reasons* (real, machine-readable facts), which is exactly what the audit rewards.
